habitat: The usable text does not describe the habitat.
summary: The colour key says it is similar to Southern Double-collared Sunbird, but the bill is longer than the head. It is endemic. The description on the same page is a short-billed olive sunbird and was not used. No matching call, status or further plumage was found. No Kemp estimate is stored.

sources.title: The Atlas of Southern African Birds, Vol. 2 (Greater Doublecollared Sunbird)

population.notes: No sourced Kruger estimate is currently available; taxonomy or later records require separate research.

viewNotes.note: The bill is longer than the head. Other marks were not in the matching text.
A flight pattern was not described.

calls.description: The matching Newman text does not describe a call. Grade A call from Grahamstown. The filename is XC249315-GDC sunbird male.mp3.

images.author: Jean-Paul Boerekamps
images.alt: Sunbird at an aloe, green head, blue and red breast and a long bill
images.caption: Greater Double-collared Sunbird in Mbombela, a male with a green head, a blue-and-red breast and a long bill. Newman’s matching text only says the bill is longer than the head.

research.note: Only the colour key is used. The description on the Greater Double-collared page does not match a long-billed bird. No Kemp block was present. Status is resident from SABAP1, which says it is not considered migratory; it suggests only local altitudinal movement, which is unconfirmed.

similar.note: The colour key separates Greater Double-collared Sunbird by a bill longer than the head. A usable plumage description of Southern Double-collared Sunbird was not found.
